value.rationale: A natural equality-case problem for a sharp and recently published two-error DNA-motivated duplication-sphere bound is fully solved for all n and q. The classification exposes \(q(q-1)^{n-1}\) maximizing sources, many with more than two symbols, and characterizes RC optimizers under arbitrary involutions. The specific exact extremizer enumeration and iff structure are useful for channel geometry and instance selection; no downstream coding theorem is claimed.
